en_access_to_document_3: If a payment is required, you can pay online or through pagoPA-enabled channels. The amount will be updated with notification costs: €2 for digital notifications, higher for registered post, which is only sent if no digital channels are available or if you do not open the communication in time
en_send_refinement: This document is a legally-binding communication inviting you to review the documents notified to you, which will have consequences for you in any case. If a payment is required, the amount to be paid will depend on the method you choose to access the notification, the type of registered post sent to you as chosen by the institution, and the number of delivery attempts. You have 120 days from the date on which the notification becomes legally valid to access the documents online. en_io_content: If you have an Electronic ID card (CIE), you can ask a person you trust to access the online documents for you. They simply need to scan the QR code with IO and follow the instructions on the app to consult the documents on your behalf.
